trap.label: to have been
trap.wrong: The mill is said to be built in 1900.
trap.right: The mill is said to have been built in 1900.
trap.why: O português usa o mesmo infinitivo para presente e passado. Em inglês, ação anterior ao relato pede to have + particípio.

mcq.q: The mill is said ___ built in 1900.
She is believed ___ a prize now.
The firm is thought ___ in trouble.

fix.wrong: The mill is said to be built in 1900.
fix.right: The mill is said to have been built in 1900.

fix.wrong: He is believed to has left.
fix.right: He is believed to have left.

fix.wrong: She is said to been rich once.
fix.right: She is said to have been rich once.

rewrite.prompt: Passado: “People say he left early.” (He is said…)
rewrite.answer: He is said to have left early.

rewrite.prompt: Presente: “People think the firm is in trouble.” (The firm…)
rewrite.answer: The firm is thought to be in trouble.

rewrite.prompt: Anterior: “People believe she won a prize.” (She…)
rewrite.answer: She is believed to have won a prize.
